description: Household electricity demand and generation data - Cyprus is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Andreas Olympios (University of Cyprus). This dataset contains hourly electricity consumption and production data for 68 households in Cyprus during the year 2016. The data were collected as part of the LIFE+ SmartPV Project, which aimed to promote a more economically and environmentally sustainable electricity grid in Cyprus and across Europe. Coverage: national (CY); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
